baslik: How the Ottomans tried to lock 5 of the world's sea gates
aciklama:
The Bosporus, the Red Sea, Hormuz, Suez and the Don–Volga: how the Ottoman Empire tried to control the chokepoints of world trade, and why some of the plans never left the paper.

What do you think? Tell me in the comments 👇

Sources: Giancarlo Casale, The Ottoman Age of Exploration; Halil İnalcık, The Ottoman Empire: The Classical Age; Encyclopaedia Britannica.
